edition.cue: Serve dessert when Eddie talks about opening a bakery.

s.note: Corner store spread of jerky, cashews, crackling and pickled onions.
s.how: Tip 150g beef jerky, 200g salted cashews and 100g pork crackling into separate bowls. Drain a 400g jar of pickled onions into a small dish. Set it all out together on the coffee table, the full corner store spread, with paper napkins.

s.note: Crisp-bottomed pork dumplings with soy, vinegar and ginger dip.
s.how: Fry 24 frozen pork dumplings flat side down in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes, add 120ml water, cover and steam 4 minutes, then fry again until crisp underneath. Mix 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp black vinegar and 1 tbsp fine ginger matchsticks for dipping.

m.note: Griddle-chopped beef and onion with melted cheese in a hero.
m.how: Fry 1 diced onion on a hot griddle, add 600g beef mince and chop it up with a spatula as it browns, seasoning well. Lay 6 slices American cheese on top and chop through until melted. Pile into 4 toasted hero rolls with shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and mayo.

w.note: Chocolate layer cake in chocolate buttercream, with candles.
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 200g caster sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 220g self-raising flour, 40g cocoa and 120ml milk. Bake in two 20cm tins at 180C for 25 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, sandwich and cover the cakes, and add birthday candles.

d.note: Drip coffee with milk and sugar in paper cups.
d.how: Brew 1 litre of drip coffee with 60g ground coffee. Pour into four paper cups with milk, about 200ml in total, and sugar to taste, and serve fast.
